title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 3, QA) - Quant - Geometry
subject: Quant

questions.q: A circular plot of land is divided into two regions by a chord of length $10 \sqrt{3}$ meters such that the chord subtends an angle of $120^{\circ}$ at the center. Then, the area, in square meters, of the smaller region is:
questions.explain: Let r be the radius. Using the law of cosines, $ (10\sqrt{3})^2 = r^2 + r^2 - 2r^2\cos(120^{\circ}) $. This gives $300 = 3r^2$, so $r=10$. The area of the sector is $\frac{120}{360}\pi r^2 = \frac{100\pi}{3}$. The area of the triangle formed by the chord and radii is $\frac{1}{2}r^2\sin(120^{\circ}) = 25\sqrt{3}$. The area of the smaller region is the area of the sector minus the area of the triangle.

questions.q: The midpoints of sides AB, BC, and AC in △ ABC are M, N, and P, respectively. The medians drawn from A, B, and C intersect the line segments MP, MN and NP at X, Y, and Z, respectively. If the area of △ ABC is 1440 sq cm, then the area, in sq cm, of △ XYZ is:
questions.explain: △ MNP is the medial triangle of △ ABC, so its area is 1/4 of Area(ABC). △ XYZ is the medial triangle of △ MNP. Thus, Area(XYZ) = (1/4) * Area(MNP) = (1/4) * (1/4) * Area(ABC) = 1440/16 = 90.

questions.q: A regular octagon ABCDEFGH has sides of length 6 cm each. Then the area, in sq. cm , of the square $A C E G$ is:
questions.explain: The side length of the square ACEG is the distance AC. By applying the Law of Cosines in triangle ABC, with angle ABC being $135^{\circ}$, we find $AC^2 = 6^2 + 6^2 - 2(6)(6)\cos(135^{\circ}) = 72 + 36\sqrt{2} = 36(2+\sqrt{2})$. This is the area.
